title: Field Dispatch on Vercel eve
description: A private 21-lesson course on Vercel eve in TypeScript. The capstone is a field dispatcher for an invented home-services business: it drafts work orders, schedules technicians, moves jobs through their workflows and builds estimates, and a person approves anything risky. It deploys to Vercel through the AI Gateway and serves a dispatcher page that anyone can open but only the owner's Google account can sign in to. Tests and deterministic evals never call a model. Part of the same agent-framework series.
